visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler with pigtails in a white and orange shirt sits on a light wood floor, holding a small green snack. Behind her are white storage bins and a table in a bright, tidy living room. (2) She stands up and walks toward a large white beanbag chair near a window, then leans back to flop onto it while looking at the ceiling. (3) The girl sits up, points her finger toward the left, and holds the green snack between her fingers with a neutral expression. (4) She squats on the floor near an orange tabby cat and extends her hand to place the snack down, focusing intently on the ground. (5) After the cat walks away, she picks the snack back up and watches the animal move across the room with a curious look. (6) The girl walks toward a woman in a tan hoodie by the stairs; natural light flows through a glass door in the background. (7) She squats over a cardboard box filled with items, reaching inside while the woman leans down to gesture and talk to her. (8) A close-up shows the girl looking defiant as she resists the woman's attempt to take the snack from her hand. (9) The woman lifts the toddler, who has a pouting expression, and carries her through the living room away from the toys. (10) A solid pink screen appears with a cartoon illustration of the girl and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE' centered at the bottom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched toddler vocalizations and a woman's calm, friendly voice are heard over an upbeat acoustic BGM with light guitar strumming. A soft rustling sound of fabric triggers this phase as the child settles on the floor. (2) A distinct pattering sound of bare feet on wood marks the start of this phase. The woman's voice maintains a playful tone with rising intonations as she instructs the girl to feed the orange tabby cat. (3) A soft thud occurs as the girl squats on the floor. The toddler repeats 'Lái lái lái' in a soft, high-pitched voice. The BGM provides a consistent rhythmic bed with moderate tempo and bright spectral weight. (4) The sound of a cardboard box being moved creates a short spectral burst. The adult's voice becomes more firm and authoritative while trying to retrieve a snack from the child, showing a shift in emotional valence. (5) A loud, high-arousal cry and sobbing from the toddler mark the final phase. The acoustic dynamism peaks as the girl expresses distress while being picked up. The BGM fades out into a clean studio silence.
